scope: Existing installed UE5.8.4 global enabled validators, canonical Script settings, exact loaded/registered/clean non-map /Game ingestion assets. No universal claim about other projects, validator policies or future engine revisions.

source_evidence.fact: Class validation begins neutral; class Invalid short-circuits. Enabled validator results combine; one class NotValidated cannot bypass enabled validators.
Invalid dominates; any Valid dominates NotValidated. Aggregate NotValidated needs all actual contributions neutral, not merely one neutral class override.

Canonical Script usecase and an ordinary resolved saved package are eligible; implementation returns only Valid or Invalid. Save usecase/in-memory/transient bypass is a different input or policy, not a route for the qualified saved-asset contract.
Enabled by default and accepts every asset; mapped successful validation returns Valid, unmatched localization route returns NotValidated.
An eligible native validator returning NotValidated without another state contribution triggers ensure. It is not a supported no-validator control.
Canonical log capture converts captured validator errors to Invalid; unloaded/load-failed assets become Invalid rather than genuine NotValidated.
Wrapper admits only exact loaded registered clean non-map /Game paths and fixes Script/detail/load/log settings. Unmapped fixture is outside this wrapper contract.

archived_native_failure.validator_statistics_limit: ReferenceRestrictions non-neutral contribution observed; individual validator enum not separately recorded. No invented contributor attribution.

decision.reason: No source-justified asset-only fixture yields genuine aggregate NotValidated under the unchanged qualified saved-asset/global policy. A separate empty-registry subsystem or disabled validators changes policy and does not close production/global coverage. No further speculative probes.

status_notvalidated.preserve: Exact returned status, per-asset details, unable/skipped counters, diagnostics and original source/capture identities. Never coerce NotValidated to Valid, Invalid or Skipped.

require_all: Known terminal of the exact owned dispatch, independently bound current process/session identity, exact requested asset paths/root and source/package identities; no stale or reused capture.
Actual native wrapper envelope: status Valid, native_invoked true, accepted true, cancellation_observed false, native_return integer0, nonempty untruncated canonical snapshot.

Canonical snapshot passes the existing bounded consumer and agrees with envelope/request. NumRequested=NumChecked=NumValid=exact request count; NumInvalid/NumUnableToValidate/NumSkipped/NumWarnings/NumExternalObjects=0; no limit reached; exact per-asset Valid details and no failure/warning diagnostics.

Canonical Script/details/load/log policy and ordinary ownership/resource/preservation gates remain unchanged. Actual invocation freshness/source attestation must be supplied by the owning capture route, not inferred from parsed JSON.

ingestion_handling_contract.consumer_vs_runtime: native_validation_snapshot_consumer.ConsumerResult.accepted is bounded data consistency, not native invocation attestation. Its existing synthetic Valid fixture can be accepted with unknown provenance and native_runtime_qualified=false. Never use that property alone as ingestion authorization.
ingestion_handling_contract.separate_gates: Validation is one gate; source/provenance/material/collision/ownership/import/save/placement admission remain independent. A covered Valid result does not close the missing NotValidated test outcome.
ingestion_handling_contract.bounded_admission: An exact asset with complete genuine Valid evidence may proceed only through already-authorized independent ingestion gates; an unvalidated asset stays held. This document does not itself dispatch imports, saves or world placement.

unchanged_enforcement.new_tests: Two exact synthetic regressions preserve/refuse coherent NotValidated and distinguish/refuse Skipped, using the unchanged actual consumer; 16 focused suite methods PASS. These are not native coverage.

preservation.no_new_scene_read_claim: Native state last proved by PackagingMinimal20261022/OriginalReopenR1/fresh-preservation-pass.json; this source-only pass made no editor calls or mutations.

security_lesson_confirmation.source_gap: Env-backed raw deed-signing key and in-process signer remain a production custody gap, not evidence of leakage. Non-exportable signing not implemented; actual deployment/custody unverified.
